description: The 2026 Ford Bronco Heritage Edition is presented in Avalanche paint and includes Equipment Group 662A, a 2.2" Eibach Stage 2 progressive spring with a four wheel alignment, 17" KMC LOBO KM728 white wheels, 37x12.50R17 BFGoodrich A/T KO3 tires, a custom retro vinyl banner, custom retro Bronco badging, paint-matched fender flares, bumpers, hood, and handles, professionally installed window tint with a lifetime warranty, and custom Katzkin leather seats, door panels, and center console lid. It also includes Lane Keep Assist, Wi-Fi Hotspot, Collision Warning, Navigation, Apple CarPlay, Android Auto, a 50-State Emissions System, and a Front License Plate Bracket.The Bronco Heritage Edition keeps the familiar Heritage treatment with a clean, squared-off profile and details that reference earlier Bronco design cues without abandoning current-model content. In Avalanche, the body color gives the truck a restrained appearance, while the matching exterior pieces carry that color across the flares, bumpers, hood hardware, and handles for a more unified look. The retro banner and revised badging add period-inspired character, and the tinted glass finishes the upper portion of the body in a way that suits the rest of the exterior changes. The attention given to the trim pieces gives the vehicle a more deliberate appearance without changing its core identity or adding anything beyond what is already listed.The suspension and wheel and tire package give the Bronco a taller stance than stock and add more visual mass around the wheel openings. The 2.2" Eibach progressive spring is paired with a four wheel alignment, which keeps the underbody modification from feeling improvised and helps the vehicle sit evenly after the change. The 17" KMC LOBO KM728 white wheels continue the Heritage theme with a finish that contrasts with the Avalanche paint, and the 37x12.50R17 BFGoodrich A/T KO3 tires add a larger footprint that fills the arches in a way that is easy to notice without being overstated. The combination leaves the Bronco with the kind of proportions that fit the Heritage Edition name while staying grounded in the actual parts fitted to this example.Inside, the custom Katzkin leather treatment extends to the seats, door panels, and center console lid, giving the cabin a more tailored feel than the standard trim surfaces alone. The listed equipment adds the expected everyday functions, including Navigation, Apple CarPlay, Android Auto, a Wi-Fi Hotspot, Lane Keep Assist, and Collision Warning, along with the 50-State Emissions System and Front License Plate Bracket. Those items keep the vehicle aligned with modern use rather than relying only on its appearance or its off-road image. The Bronco's interior remains practical, but the added upholstery work brings more cohesion to the cabin materials and ties the modified exterior to the rest of the vehicle in a straightforward way.Taken together, the Heritage Edition keeps its recognizable Bronco character while layering in equipment and cosmetic changes that are easy to identify from the supplied details. The Avalanche finish, the retro-inspired exterior accents, the stance, and the custom interior treatment all contribute to a vehicle that has been revised in visible ways without departing from its stated options and modifications. In the 2015 Jeep Wrangler Sport, every drive is an opportunity for adventure. With its blend of power, style, and capability, it's ready to take you wherever your heart desires. Embrace the journey and make every mile count with this exceptional vehicle.
